questionText: Which of the following statements best describes the testing principle "context-driven testing"? chúng tôi đã tra cứu thì thấy ý nghĩa của context-driven testing là bằng với test is context dependent 1 nguyên lý của test
options: Testing is performed differently depending on the type of software, the risks involved, and the project environment.
The same testing process and techniques should be applied to all projects regardless of the product being developed.
Testing activities should only start once the code is fully developed and the environment is ready
The main goal of testing is to prove that the software is 100% free of defects before it is released.
correctAnswer: Testing is performed differently depending on the type of software, the risks involved, and the project environment.
